Name: Vanilla-Style Caleb Portraits
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I like my characters to all be done in a vanilla style so I've been utilizing Poltergeister & Jazzybee's [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdv-creator-masc]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url] to give some custom NPCs a makeover! I decided to share the ones that have open permissions or I've been given permission for in case you're OCD like me.

This is a portrait replacement for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32814]Caleb - Custom NPC[/url] by shiiteyanyo. Just download, drag and drop over the original mod files, and allow to overwrite. Enjoy!

*Note: this does NOT need Portraiture

~Like my work? [url=https://ko-fi.com/silvermoonchan]Buy me a coffee![/url] ☕
